name: Sakai (Ibaraki, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Sakai town emblem in white: a broken ring with a horizontal bar at the top, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Sakai, a town in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 29 November 1978; the emblem dates from 26 September 1966.

features.role: Sakai town emblem — a broken ring with a horizontal bar at the top, like a stylised character
